0.reason: The separator config is only pushed into a flag's value by Command.set (the CLI parse path) and Command.Set. The env/file path in command_run.go calls flag.PostParse(), which calls f.Set directly and never calls setMultiValueParsingConfig. A slice flag filled from an env var or file therefore splits with the default separator (flagSplitMultiValues falls back to defaultSliceFlagSeparator) and ignores DisableSliceFlagSeparator, SliceFlagSeparator and MapFlagKeyValueSeparator. The old globals applied to every source, so this is a regression.
